artifacts.summary: Settles the plan-time reachability question (planner-agent.md Stage 4 item 13 is the sole project/** read mechanism, gated on task_types AND a plan-authoring keyword, not on load_when.agents) and identifies what remains undone after a prior cross-repo landing of the same issue-log entry's generic substance (the concrete worked example and the twelve-spelling grep recipe).

memory_candidates.content: planner-agent.md's ONLY mechanism for reading project/** domain context at plan time is Stage 4 item 13 ('Surface This Domain's Plan-Authoring Gotchas'): it queries .claude/context/index.json for entries whose load_when.task_types[] matches the dispatch's task_type AND whose keywords[]/topics[] contain the literal string 'plan-authoring' -- load_when.agents[] is irrelevant to this query and MUST NOT name planner-agent (explicit MUST NOT in planner-agent.md, reinforced by context-discovery.md's Cross-Domain-Shared-Agent Hazard section). To make an existing domain context file reachable at plan time, the narrowest fix is adding the 'plan-authoring' keyword to its own index entry -- no change to planner-agent.md itself is needed. Confirmed live: plan-authoring-gate-collisions.md is the only entry in the whole agent-system tree currently tagged this way, and its load_when.agents correctly names only the two domain-exclusive lean agents, never planner-agent.

A conclusion-stage channel (a) orchestrate dispatch running in one repository (~/Projects/BimodalLogic) can independently harvest and land the SAME issue-log finding that a separate task in a different repository (nvim config) is simultaneously tasked with recording, with zero detectability at dispatch time -- no dependency edge or file_scope overlap gate spans two different repositories. When re-reading a 'provenance' pointer in a dispatch record, always re-check the target file's live current state before planning edits: the generic substance may already be landed, with only the concrete specifics (worked examples, enumerated recipes) and a secondary leg (e.g. an index-entries.json reachability tag) left undone.
